en-US.description: The Peak Analysis Module calculates various parameters for detected peaks, such as height, width, slope, area and various time based parameters. The parameter values are displayed in a table and can be exported to other applications.
en-US.longDescription:
The Peak Analysis Module calculates various parameters for detected peaks, such as height, width, slope, area and various time based parameters. The parameter values are displayed in a table and can be exported to other applications.
The module is suitable for analyzing peaks in areas of research such as:
- Isolated tissue studies
- Hemodynamic measurements
- Amperometry
- Cardiac action potentials
- Spontaneous synaptic potentials and currents
en-US.name: ADInstruments Peak Analysis

zh-CN.description: Peak Analysis 模块可计算检测到的各类峰参数，包括高度、宽度、斜率、面积及多种时间相关参数。所有参数值将以表格形式呈现，并支持导出至其他应用程序。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Peak Analysis 模块可计算检测到的各类峰参数，包括高度、宽度、斜率、面积及多种时间相关参数。所有参数值将以表格形式呈现，并支持导出至其他应用程序。
该模块适用于以下研究领域的峰分析：
- 离体组织研究
- 血流动力学测量
- 安培检测技术
- 心脏动作电位
- 自发性突触电位与电流
